speaker: Doctor
text: The normal CT scan rules out surgical complications like obstruction or hernia. Given the severe hypoglycemia, recent gastric surgery, and psychiatric history, I suspect intentional insulin or sulfonylurea overdose. REQUEST TEST: Insulin_level, C_peptide_level, Sulfonylurea_screen

speaker: Doctor
text: A normal C-peptide level effectively rules out a sulfonylurea overdose or endogenous insulin hypersecretion.
